meta.target: R_z(theta) = diag(exp(-i theta/2), exp(i theta/2)) at the default price (1, 3)
meta.angles: ids 0-99: uniform in [0, 2 pi), random.Random(20261116); ids 500-519: |theta| log-uniform in [1e-6, 1e-1] with a random sign, random.Random(20261117). clifford_t uses all 120, sqrt_t ids 0-49
meta.clifford_t: t_count: the least T-count of the Ross-Selinger search with the level order corrected (pygridsynth, tolerance 2 epsilon, minimum over the plain and phased region of each level)
meta.sqrt_t: reference: the native Clifford+sqrt(T) cost of an external synthesiser at price (1, 3) and its default deadline, run as a black box; cost, fast_cost: QuickSynth at a00cf60, default and fast
meta.zz: the ZZ angles of the trotter, qaoa and adiabatic benchmark workloads; t_count, cost, fast_cost: QuickSynth at a00cf60
meta.diagonal: the runs of golden_synthesise.json whose target is Clifford-equivalent to a z-rotation; cost: stage 0 at a00cf60 with the run's gate set
meta.near_exact: theta = k pi/4 + c epsilon, k = 0, 1, 2, c = 3, -3, 10, -10: directions whose rotation body holds a slab of points; t_count: as clifford_t; cost, fast_cost: QuickSynth Clifford+sqrt(T) after the slab fixes, default and fast
